name: Pollution Consent to Establish (CTE)
description: Required for industries that may discharge effluents or emit pollutants.
plainLanguageExplanation: Your factory may need environmental approval before starting construction or operations.

name: Fire Safety NOC
description: Mandatory safety clearance for factory buildings and commercial structures.
plainLanguageExplanation: Ensures your building meets safety standards to protect workers from fire hazards.

name: FSSAI License
authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
description: Required for any business involved in food processing, manufacturing, or distribution.
plainLanguageExplanation: Required since your business deals with food, ensuring hygiene and safety standards.

name: Building Plan Approval
description: Approval of architectural and structural plans before construction begins.
plainLanguageExplanation: Permission from the local authority confirming your factory design is structurally safe.
